pages.title: Iron Man Armor Model 37
pages.wikitext:
{{Marvel Database:Item Template | Title = [[Iron Man Armor|Iron Man Armor Model 37
Bleeding Edge Armor]] | Image = Iron Man Armor Model 37 from Fear Itself Vol 1 1 cover.jpg | Name = Iron Man Armor Model 37{{r|Avengers: Roll Call Vol 1 1}} | Aliases = * Stark Enhancile MK X{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 500}} * Iron Destroyer{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 510}} | Model = 37 | Version = 2 | Reality = Earth-616 | LeadDesigner = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] | AdditionalDesigners = [[Reed Richards (Earth-616)|Reed Richards]] | PlaceOfCreation = [[Baxter Building]], [[New York City]], [[New York (State)|New York]] | PlaceOfDestruction = | Origin = An internal redesign of Stark's mind, body, and Iron Man. | Type = Iron Man Armor | Dimensions = Approximately 6'6" | Weight = 400 lbs | Creators = Matt Fraction; Ryan Meinerding | First = Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 25 | History = Deemed as "bleeding edge," this armor was created as [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] essentially reinvented himself and the armor. Being called an upgrade to Extremis by [[Reed Richards (Earth-616)|Mr. Fantastic]], Tony Stark corrected this comment by saying, "Nah - this is what comes next." It was the first armor powered entirely by [[Repulsor|repulsor technology]] via Stark's new device, the [[Arc Reactor|R.T. node]].{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 25}} During the [[Fear Itself|War of the Serpent]], [[Odin Borson (Earth-616)|Odin Borson]] let Stark have access to the [[Furnaces of Nidavellir|forges]] of [[Nidavellir]], and created an arsenal of [[Uru]] weapons to combat the enemy forces razing the Earth.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 506}} In order to acquire his own enhancements, Tony merged the systems of the Bleeding Edge Armor with Uru, turning it into the "Iron Destroyer" until the battle ended.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 509}} When Odin left to [[Asgard (Realm)|Asgard]], the enhancements of the Uru weapons and the Iron Destroyer were gone, so Tony vented the Uru from the suit's structure and gave it back to the forges along with the rest of the weapons to be melted.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 510}} [[File:Iron Man Armor Model 37 from Fear Itself Vol 1 7 001.jpg|thumb|left|Iron Destroyer]] During [[Avengers vs. X-Men|the conflict between the Avengers and the X-Men]], a version of the suit was used that was composed of carbon nanotubes, in order to effectively fight against [[Max Eisenhardt (Earth-616)|Magneto]].{{r|AVX: Vs Vol 1 1}} Stark was forced to discard the armor after his competency as the suit's pilot was called into question (due to machinations of the [[Mandarin (Earth-616)|Mandarin]]). [[Reed Richards (Earth-616)|Mr. Fantastic]] assisted Tony in purging the armor from his body after received orders from the U.S. government; and the two successfully removed all components from Tony's body. They would also render the tech completely inert, denying all possibility of reverse engineering or research to duplication.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 517}} Tony would later create a nanotech-free version of the suit for use after [[Francis Castle (Earth-616)|Punisher]] stole the [[Iron Man Armor Model 42|Model 42]] during his battle against the [[Avengers (Earth-616)|Avengers]].{{r|Punisher: War Zone Vol 3 5}} ==Capabilities== This entire armor is kept inside Tony's body until mentally commanded, at which point it manifests itself as the Iron Man Armor. The armor is made up of Nano-Machines that can now be commanded to turn into any type of structure upon Stark's skin. For example, the nano-machines can turn into clothes, other armors, or even different beings completely, by having the nano-machines change their properties into whatever Stark wants them to be. It can also dissociate to transform into the Iron Man armor whenever Stark wishes. The armor and Stark's own transhuman body are powered by the high-yield [[Arc Reactor|R.T. node]] mounted in his chest. The high output of the node has greatly augmented Stark's intelligence and provided him with superhuman-level multitasking and learning capabilities. Unlike earlier armors, this new armor does not appear to rely on motors and servos for motion. Instead, the nano-machines create a second layer of artificial muscle over Stark's body, upon which additional structures are assembled. This also enables the armor to {{Power|Regeneration|self-repair}} and be almost invulnerable, as the armor is capable of {{Power|Limited Shapeshifting|transforming}} and healing itself, by having the constantly replicating nano-machines replace anything that is lost or used, as long as the power output from the arc reactor isn't interrupted or terminated. This allowed it to take blows from a [[Phoenix Force (Earth-616)|Phoenix]] Avatar [[Scott Summers (Earth-616)|Cyclops]] and have power left to regenerate.{{r|Avengers vs. X-Men Vol 1 10}} [[File:Iron Man Armor Model 37 from Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 517 001.jpg|thumb|left|Inert]] The neurokinetic user-controlled morphologic nanoparticle bundles that form the suit reside in Stark's body, and form a fibrous wetweb of iron and platinum, that can be commanded to form any type of structure upon Stark's skin, from weaponry to clothing, and can even stop a howitzer shell.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 30}} Known weaponry includes repulsors, uni-beam, pulse bolts, tasers,{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 500}} missiles,{{r|Hulk Vol 2 25}} an energy blade,{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 505}} and roughly 17,000 microscopic telepathic tasers that shock telepaths the more they think.{{r|Avengers vs. X-Men Vol 1 2}} Unusual for Iron Man Armors, the suit possessed {{Power|Optic Blasts|optic blasts}}.{{r|Avengers Vol 4 21}} Defenses include deflector shields and anti-magnetism safeguards.{{r|Avengers vs. X-Men Vol 1 1}} It has resisted the hacking of the [[Herbert Wyndham (Earth-616)|High Evolutionary]].{{r|Iron Man/Thor Vol 1 2}} Other type of weapons and upgrades seems to be created by Stark's imagination, such as a boxing glove,{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 506}} large guns extending from his arms,{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 30}} or cannons.{{r|Carnage Vol 1 5}} The suit's repulsors, which are located around the knuckles, chest, back and legs of the armor, as well as in the traditional palms, now function also as cameras, or "eyeballs," which afford Stark a 360-degree panoramic view around himself.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 30}} Those same repulsors are strong enough to vaporize a flaming plane wing into dust.{{r|Avengers vs. X-Men Vol 1 1}} It has {{Power|Telepathic Immunity|resisted the telephaty}} from [[Charles Xavier (Earth-616)|Professor X]].{{r|Avengers Vol 4 8}} ==Alternate Realities== ===Marvel Adventures ([[Earth-20051]])=== [[File:Iron Man Armor Model 37 from Marvel Adventures Super Heroes Vol 2 17 001.png|thumb|right]] The Armor was hacked by the [[René Rodin (Earth-20051)|Mad Thinker]], but [[Clinton Barton (Earth-20051)|Hawkeye]] managed to stop his rampage with aid from Stark.{{r|Marvel Adventures Super Heroes Vol 2 17}} {{clear}} ---- | CurrentOwner = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] | PreviousOwners = | Notes = * This armor was originally identified as the Iron Man Armor Model 37 in 2012's {{cl|Avengers: Roll Call Vol 1 1}}. In 2018, the [[:Category:Many Armors of Iron Man Variants|"Many Armors of Iron Man"]] variant cover series for {{cl|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 1}} bumped up the numeration for this suit as well as Models [[Iron Man Armor Model 16|16]], [[Iron Man Armor Model 22|22]], [[Iron Man Armor Model 29|29]] due to splitting [[Iron Man Armor Model 13|Model 13]] into two distinct suits. The cover series implies other changes, as the designations for Models [[Iron Man Armor Model 42|42]], [[Iron Man Armor Model 45|45]], [[Iron Man Armor Model 50|50]] and [[Iron Man Armor Model 51|51]] remain unchanged. Since the limited scope of the cover series makes it impossible to determine the full extent of changes in numeration (as it only spotlighted twenty suits), the Marvel Database will prioritize the numbering from {{cl|Avengers: Roll Call Vol 1 1}}. * This armor was designed by [[Ryan Meinerding]].{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 25}} Meinerding is the Head of Visual Development for [[Marvel Studios]], having worked as a character designer and concept artist in numerous films including ''[[Iron Man (film)|Iron Man]]'', ''[[Iron Man 2 (film)|Iron Man 2]]'', ''[[Iron Man 3 (film)|Iron Man 3]]'', ''[[Marvel's The Avengers]]'', ''[[Avengers: Age of Ultron]]'', ''[[Avengers: Infinity War]]'' and ''[[Avengers: Endgame]]''. He co-designed many of [[Anthony Stark (Earth-199999)|Iron Man]]'s cinematic suits, including the MKs [[Iron Man Armor MK I (Earth-199999)|I]], [[Iron Man Armor MK VI (Earth-199999)|VI]], [[Iron Man Armor MK XLII (Earth-199999)|XLII]] and [[Iron Man Armor MK LXXXV (Earth-199999)|LXXXV]], as well [[James Rhodes (Earth-199999)|War Machine]]'s MKs [[War Machine Armor MK I (Earth-199999)|I]] and [[War Machine Armor MK II (Earth-199999)|II]]. | Trivia = * When this armor was adapted into a 3.75" action figure for the Series 3 of Hasbro's ''Marvel Universe'' toyline, the package misidentified it as the "[https://marvelousnews.com/database/index.php?itemid=1578 Modular Armor Iron Man]." | Links = }} [[Category:Nanobots]] [[Category:Uru]]

| History                 = This armor was created by Tony Stark shortly after the [[Iron Man Armor Model 3|previous model]] was damaged beyond repair battling the [[Harold Hogan (Earth-616)|Freak]]. This armor was not only more flexible, but also returned to a noseless faceplate.{{r|Iron Man Vol 1 85}} The armor later underwent several overhauls and was one of the longest models ever used.

[[File:Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 14 Textless.jpg|thumb|left|150px]]
[[James Rhodes (Earth-616)|Jim Rhodes]] replaced Stark as Iron Man for a considerable time using this armor. [[Harold Hogan (Earth-616)|Happy Hogan]], [[Edward March (Earth-616)|Eddie March]], and [[Clayton Wilson (Earth-616)|Force]] also wore it on different occasions. 

Despite having developed various more advanced armors since this version, Tony tends to default to a model of this armor when his modern suit has been destroyed or disabled and he lacks the time, resources or inclination to create a more advanced replacement. One example of this was when he destroyed his sentient armor and was afraid of creating a new, modern version in case he re-created the accident that gave his previous armor sentience.{{r|Iron Man Vol 3 27}}

During the Siege of Asgard, Tony was given a modified version of the Model 4 by Jarvis, who sent Young Avenger Speed to give it to him, and he used it to override Norman Osborn's Iron Patriot armor.{{r|Siege Vol 1 2}} Then, during the battle with the Void, Iron Man overrode the H.A.M.M.E.R. Helicarrier and used it as a bullet to hit the Void, turning him back into Robert Reynolds before Thor killed him.{{r|Siege Vol 1 4}}

[[File:Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 14 Silvestri Variant Textless.jpg|thumb|left|150px]]

When [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] undertook Stark Resilient, he dismantled and melted one of the various models of this armor.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 26}} After thwarting the Mandarin's latest plan required him to destroy his existing modern armors to ensure that none of the Mandarin's compromised code remained in his systems, Tony retrieved a version of this armor from the Avengers archives. {{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 527}}

==Capabilities==
'''{{Power|Computer Hacking Skills|Computer Hacking}}:''' The armor was able to hack [[Deviant Skrulls|Skrull]] technology.{{r|Secret Invasion Vol 1 8}}

[[Reed Richards (Earth-616)|Reed Richards]] praised the armor's sophistication and clear, straightforward design.{{r|Marvel Super Heroes Secret Wars Vol 1 4}}{{r|Marvel Super Heroes Secret Wars Vol 1 8}} Its structure was improved with 3D knitting. In addition, a force field helped keep the armor rigid.{{r|Iron Man Vol 1 85}} The armor used solar power (but recharged slowly without a large source of electricity),{{r|Iron Man Vol 1 150}} and integrated micro-circuitry. A thermocouple was used to handle extreme temperature and convert it to usable power, but it could be overloaded.

[[File:Iron Man Armor Model 4 from Iron Man Vol 1 85 0001.jpg|thumb|150px]]

Repulsor rays were standard weaponry. The variobeam/unibeam was capable of various effects. A tractor beam could be used to pull or tow objects. The most recent version of the armor was able to use pulse bolts.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 1 23}} The shoulders could open up to unleash bullet fire.{{r|Taco Bell/Invincible Iron Man Vol 1 1}} The repulsor rays could charge up into balls before firing for greater effect.{{r|Secret Empire Vol 1 4}} Gyro-stabilizers were used in the boot jets.

Power pods were capable of various functions such as boosting other systems or being set to detonate. The armor can use the override function, which unleashes a safe 800% to 3,200% up to a very dangerous 5,000% amplification of all offensive systems. This function was used to fight and defeat the [[Bruce Banner (Earth-616)|Hulk]], although it almost cost the user's life immediately afterward.{{r|Iron Man Vol 1 132}} ECM jamming was used to evade detection.

[[File:Iron Man Vol 1 85 page 14.jpg|thumb|left|Assembled for the first time]]

A hologram emitter created multiple images to make the armor harder to target. In addition to the sonic emitter, a voice distorter helped protect Stark's identity and could also be used to duplicate sounds. The armor could travel underground. Freon could be emitted and a built-in fire extinguisher handled internal and external fire. Finger lasers and a "sabresaw" were available for cutting through objects. The fingers could be turned into multipurpose tools for tech work.{{r|Secret Empire: Brave New World Vol 1 2}} Life support was improved; the pacemaker was no longer needed after successful heart surgery. A slave circuit was added to control older armors after the incident with "Weasel" Willis. However, this was a weakness when [[Midas (Earth-616)|Midas]] attempted to gain control of the armors.

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) with Iron Man Armor MK V from Iron Man Vol 1 85 001.jpg|thumb|right]]

Sensors were upgraded with a full-band transceiver, infrared, and a "life detector" that was keyed to several important personnel. The armor took a blast that destroyed a large warehouse and leveled the surrounding area at point blank range.{{r|Iron Man: Bad Blood Vol 1 3}} The armor was able to tank several cutting-edge missiles and a blow from the [[Crimson Dynamo Armor Mark IV-X|Crimson Dynamo]].{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 14}} The armor on its last legs, figuratively speaking, was able to fly nine hours straight, use the operative system while the user was sleeping, play a video, and take an RPG to the face before giving out.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 17}} The armor is durable enough to tank repulsor blasts from [[Ultron (Earth-616)|Ultron]] and strong enough to punch him a few feet back when he is made of [[Adamantium]].{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 19}}

The armor possessed circuitry later models like [[Iron Man Armor Model 29|Extremis]] lacked, such as accelerators and eight to nine diodes,{{r|Mighty Avengers Vol 1 10}} which Tony used alongside pieces of [[Doctor Doom's Armor]] to build a time machine with help from the Monarch of Latveria.{{r|Iron Man Vol 1 150}}

| History                 = After [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] was forced by the [[Mandarin (Earth-616)|Mandarin]] to build the Titanomechs without access to his own armor, he created a new armor with the help of [[Ezekiel Stane (Earth-616)|Zeke Stane]] to rebel against the Mandarin along with the other villains forced to work for him and aid other villains who decided to help him.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 523}}

==Capabilities==
Constructed in secret while Stark was held captive in Mandarin City, the circumstances of the Model 40's birth were not unlike ones Stark endured when he designed the original Iron Man armor.

[[File:Invincible Iron Man Vol 2 523 Textless.jpg|thumb|left]]
The Model 40 was intended for durability and heavy combat, made mainly to enable Stark and his allies to escape captivity while fighting back against the Mandarin, his private army, and destroy the "Titanomech" machines Stark was being forced to build. Assembled mainly from scavenged, stolen and jury-rigged parts, the Model 40 bore a distinctly improvised and reinforced appearance, with externally-mounted struts protecting Stark's neck and head, as well as a backpack-like rear thruster, and large repulsor emitters.

The suit was not devoid of advanced technology, though. It was capable of interfacing with the Swarm, a large concentration of microscopic, airborne, repulsor-powered mini-computers designed and released by Stark Resilient (renamed Resilient since Stark's departure) as an alternative solution to "Cloud"-based computing.

Stark was able to tap into the Swarm and weaponize trillions of micro-repulsor batteries within it to form a massive repulsor cannon, using it to destroy several Titanomechs and end the Mandarin's schemes.

{{Marvel Database:Item Template | Image = Iron Man Armor Model 42 from Iron Man Vol 4 1 Pagulayan Variant Textless.jpg | Name = Iron Man Armor Model 42{{r|All-New, All-Different Marvel Universe Vol 1 1}} | Title = [[Iron Man Armor|Iron Man Armor Model 42]] | Aliases = Armor 616{{r|Infinity: Heist Vol 1 4}} | Model = 42 | Version = 2 | Reality = Earth-616 | LeadDesigner = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] | AdditionalDesigners = | PlaceOfCreation = [[Tony Stark's SoHo Penthouse]] | PlaceOfDestruction = | Origin = | Type = Iron Man Armor | Dimensions = | Weight = | Creators = Kieron Gillen; Carlo Pagulayan | First = Iron Man Vol 4 1 | History = When [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] returned to Earth, after deciding to take time to clear his mind, he started creating many new technologies for himself. One of these being this new armor, primarily used by Tony to test new technological developments.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 1}} | Properties = ===Overview=== This armor is powered by numerous [[Arc Reactor|Repulsor Tech cores]], with "Repulsor Core One" being the one implanted in Tony Stark's chest. This armor's first version was composed of a liquid smart-metal which could be easily stored in a briefcase and be rapidly aligned to a subdermal guide to form the suit exoskeleton. However, this metal was not meant for battle, but rapid testing.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 1}} The newest model's composition allows the user of the suit to attach/de-attach different kind of modules depending on the situation in a similar (but more limited) way to the [[Modular Armor|Iron Man Armor Model 13]]. The suit can also be retracted into a "backpack" to allow its user's arms and legs mobility, but easy to immediately reassemble.{{r|Indestructible Hulk Vol 1 2}} [[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) by Granov 002.jpg|thumb|left]] Using technology given to him by [[Rocket Raccoon (Earth-616)|Rocket Raccoon]],{{cite|ref=true|url=http://brevoortformspring.tumblr.com/post/54012973503/in-the-preview-to-gotg-4-iron-man-wants-a-way-to|title=New Brevoort Formspring — In the Preview to GotG#4 Iron Man wants a way to...|work=Tumblr|first=Tom|last=Brevoort|date=27 June 2013|accessdate=7 October 2018}} Tony created the "[[Stark Omniversal Multitasking Software]]"{{r|Avengers Vol 5 12}} to allow him to remotely control the armor on Earth via his [[Iron Man Armor Model 44|Deep-Space Armor]]. This software was intended for emergencies when Stark was needed on Earth while he was in space with the [[Guardians of the Galaxy (Earth-616)|Guardians of the Galaxy]]. The software approximate communication range is seven hundred light years.{{r|Secret Avengers Vol 2 4}} At least two other Model 42 armors, colored in the classic red and gold scheme, could be operated remotely.{{r|Iron Man Presented by DJI Vol 1 1}} In order to access the modular ability, this armor can be accompanied by a mobile armory controlled by Stark's [[H.E.L.E.N. (Earth-616)|newest A.I.]] and be adapted to use different technologies.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 2}}. The code "Hdgk(X)=H2k(X,Q)∩Hk,k(X)" is capable of overriding the armor in order to make it respond to whomever recites it.{{r|Original Sin Vol 1 7}} [[File:Iron Man Armor Model 42 from Iron Man Presented by DJI Vol 1 1 001.jpg|thumb|right|Remotely Operated Red & Gold Model 42]] ===Offensive Powers=== The armor features regular weaponry such as repulsor rays, employing the latest version, Mark IVa.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 2}} The suit can also deploy whips for either attack or to carry things.{{r|Indestructible Hulk Annual Vol 1 1}} The armor is strong enough to momentarily halt the crushing weight of a [[Stark Sentinel MK I|Stark Sentinel]] and continue to do so even when armor integrity was compromised.{{r|Avengers & X-Men: AXIS Vol 1 2}} The suit, grounded and with almost no power can fire triple repulsor-based missiles.{{r|Avengers & X-Men: AXIS Vol 1 2}} The suit also comes with numerous add-ons that add to the armors firepower. The suit can also concentrate repulsors into a high-pressure burst and deliver a powerful blow via the fist.{{r|Iron Man: Fatal Frontier Infinite Comic Vol 1 10}} The suit can project a force shield into a concussive force that blows an enemy assailant back.{{r|Iron Man: Fatal Frontier Infinite Comic Vol 1 10}} The armor can fire its gauntlets and be remotely controlled to carry out commands. They also come equipped with induction fields that were able drain all the power from an alternate futures [[Victor von Doom (Earth-13859)|Dr. Doom's]] suit of armor.{{r|Iron Man: Fatal Frontier Infinite Comic Vol 1 10}} The suit can launch eight homing missiles from its back.{{r|Avengers Vol 5 27}} ====Known Add-ons==== * Wrist-mounted armor piercing taser guns.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 1}} * Hacking units.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 2}} * UV laser.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 2}} * Repulsor mini-gun.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 2}} * Explosive launcher unit.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 5}} * Augmented back-thrusts gear.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 5}} * Anti-electric counter measure shields.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 5}} * Wrist-mounted missiles.{{r|Indestructible Hulk Vol 1 17}} Anthony Stark (Earth-616) from Iron Man Vol 4 1 004.jpg|Taser gun add-on Anthony Stark (Earth-616) from Iron Man Vol 4 5 002.jpg|Explosive launcher unit and back thrust gear Anthony Stark (Earth-616) from Indestructible Hulk Vol 1 17 004.jpg|Firing MK I|Stark Sentinel]] to even functioning as the armor integrity slowly fell, and even after it collapsed{{r|Avengers & X-Men: AXIS Vol 1 2}}, a direct blow from the [[Terrax's Axe|Cosmic Axe]]{{r|New Avengers Vol 3 5}}, the [[Kevin Connor (Earth-616)|Starbrand]]{{r|Avengers Vol 5 8}}, and [[Adam Blackveil (Earth-616)|Nightmask]].{{r|Avengers Vol 5 9}} The armor can resist telepathy from the [[Johann Shmidt (Clone) (Earth-616)|Red Onslaught]], comes equipped with a telepathic inverter that can find the right inverted frequence to clear all telepathy in the area, and place a disruptor to blanket the area of Los Angeles from further manipulation.{{r|Avengers & X-Men: AXIS Vol 1 1}} The armor can also contantly emit this telepathic disruptor directly from the suit until it runs out of power.{{r|Avengers & X-Men: AXIS Vol 1 2}}{{r|Avengers & X-Men: AXIS Vol 1 3}} The suit can take power from outside sources, use the Override feature{{r|Avengers & X-Men: AXIS Vol 1 3}}{{r|Avengers & X-Men: AXIS Vol 1 2}}, project and interact with holograms{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 1}}, and turn into a suitcase that opens up to encase the user.{{r|Avengers Vol 5 7}} The armor can project shields that are built to take heavy blows but not small and dense beams.{{r|Iron Man: Fatal Frontier Infinite Comic Vol 1 4}} The armor comes equipped with a medical system that blocks the users pain receptors.{{r|Iron Man: Fatal Frontier Infinite Comic Vol 1 4}} The armor comes equipped with a thermocouple that is strong enough to absorb heat until there is nothing left but cold that forms up as ice around the enemy combatant.{{r|Iron Man: Fatal Frontier Infinite Comic Vol 1 4}} The armor is capable of absorbing the entirety of the moon's [[Phlogistone]] and releasing it into space thanks to [[File:Iron Man Vol 4 3 Pagulayan Variant Textless.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Armor's capabilities]]

When the [[Extremis (Virus)|Extremis virus]] was recreated by [[Advanced Idea Mechanics (Earth-616)|A.I.M.]] and sold to different people around the world, [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] decided to track down and destroy any type of Extremis sample that could fall in the wrong hands.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 1}} One of the samples he had to retrieve was in the secured mansion of a Colombian drug dealer. [[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) from Iron Man Vol 4 3 003.jpg|thumb|150px|left|Hologram disguise]]

Being powered by the [[Arc Reactor|R.T. node]], this suit possesses lightbending technology for camouflage, holograms for disguise, and non-fatal and silent weaponry. It can use repulsors, but at roughly 10% the max output.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 3}} The suit also possesses tasers.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 24}} The suit also possessed knockout gas.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 3}} The suit's shielding is capable of resisting a force blast from the Spectral [[Mandarin's Rings|Mandarin Ring]], a beam of energy so powerful it can destroy the bonds between atoms and molecules.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 24}} The suit's holograms can also be used to create illusions.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 25}} The space between the joints of the suit is increased, so to reduce the sound caused by movement.<ref>[http://marvel.com/videos/watch/4344/marvel_ar_carlo_pagulayan_on_armor Marvel AR: Carlo Pagulayan on Armor | News | Marvel.com]</ref> The armor can also conceal itself but not the wearer to let its user be protected, but appear normally clothed.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 20}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) from Iron Man Vol 4 4 008.jpg|thumb|left|Immense firepower]]
One of the samples he had to retrieve was from a French catacomb, where 13 super-powered subjects were created. In order to battle more than a dozen of super-humans at the same time, this armor was created and fitted with a high amount of devastating firepower to deal with them.{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 4}}

This suit was taken by Tony in his mobile armory to his space trip, and was deployed by Iron Man during the fight against [[Recorder 451 (Earth-616)|Recorder 451]].{{r|Iron Man Vol 4 15}}

When the Hulk tried to kill Iron Man after discovering that Stark had sabotaged the Gamma Bomb which turned him into a monster, even though it was later revealed by doing so Tony saved Banner's life, Tony deployed this armor to fight him after [[Iron Man Armor Model 49|another suit]] had been heavily damaged. The Heavy Duty Armor wasn't really effective, as the Hulk resisted Iron Man firing all its arsenal, and quickly turned the suit into scrap.{{r|Original Sin Vol 1 3.4}}

==Capabilities==
[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) from Iron Man Vol 4 4 006.jpg|thumb|150px|left|Shield]]
According to Stark himself, this suit has been designed to battle the [[Bruce Banner (Earth-616)|Hulk]]. [[File:Iron Man Vol 1 142 Textless.jpg|thumb|left]]

[[File:Iron Man Armor Model 5 from Iron Man Vol 1 142 001.jpg|thumb|left]]

[[File:Scarlet Spider Vol 2 16 Many Armors of Iron Man Variant Textless.jpg|thumb|right]]
The concept of a space-especific armor would be revisited by Stark with the models [[Iron Man Armor Model 10|10]], [[Iron Man Armor Model 18|18]], [[Iron Man Armor Model 27|27]] and [[Iron Man Armor Model 45|45]].

==Capabilities==
Life support and other systems are designed primarily for space; the armor is heavy and awkward in normal gravity conditions. Its control system is highly sensitive. An auto-camera and extendable exo-units are used for exploration. Sonar detects vibrations despite a lack of atmosphere. Thermographs provide detailed information. {{Power|Repulsor Ray|Repulsors}} were standard. In addition to the standard array the unibeam could use a deflector beam to push objects. The armor also has concussion beams mounted in its epaulets.

{{Marvel Database:Item Template | Title = [[Iron Man Armor|Endo-Sym Armor]] | Image = Iron Man Armor Model 50 from Superior Iron Man TPB Vol 1 1 Infamous 001.jpg | Name = Iron Man Armor Model 50{{r|All-New, All-Different Marvel Universe Vol 1 1}} | Aliases = [[Endo-Sym Armor]]{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 1}} | CurrentOwner = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] | PreviousOwners = | AlternateOwners = | Type = Iron Man Armor | Material = | Dimensions = | Weight = | Origin = | Reality = Earth-616 | LeadDesigner = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] | AdditionalDesigners = | PlaceOfCreation = [[San Francisco]] | PlaceOfDestruction = | Creators = Tom Taylor; Yıldıray Çınar | First = Avengers Vol 5 32 | First2 = (Cameo)
{{sld|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 1}}(Full appearance) | History = Following the inversion spell which altered his moral axis,{{r|Avengers & X-Men: AXIS Vol 1 3}} Tony Stark moved to [[San Francisco]] where he planned on transforming the city into a utopia fed by exorbitant fees paid to [[Stark Industries (Earth-616)|Stark Industries]] for [[Extremis (Virus)|Extremis 3.0]]. He designed a new suit of symbiotic, biological armor, partially based on [[Symbiotes|symbiote]] biology, from which he had taken "building blocks" directly to integrate into the suit.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 1}} | Properties = [[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) from Superior Iron Man Vol 1 1 002.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Suit-up]] The Endo-Sym Armor is a full liquid smart-metal which hardens instantly on connection with the user's body. Unlike another suit of similar abilities, the [[Iron Man Armor Model 37]], this suit is based on [[Symbiotes|symbiote]] biology, so it doesn't rely on tech for the initial bonding process with its user, the start-up is completely psionic.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 1}} The armor can emit [[Extremis (Virus)|Extremis 3.0]] through the surrounding area by the internet and fire a modified strain of [[Extremis (Virus)|Extremis 3.0]] to apply to a specific part of the targets body via electrical discharge.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 2}}{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 3}} The psionic bonding with the suit allows its user to control it remotely,{{r|Avengers & X-Men: AXIS Vol 1 6}} and call for it with no needs of electronics. Stark has stated that the suit can "feel" him the same way he can "feel" the suit, and referred to it as "alive".{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 2}} This connection extends to the point of it forming fully into a humanoid form that has similarities to that of a symbiote suit even when not bonded to someone, to punch through barriers in an attempt to get to its owner at his psionic command, but it does not have intelligence of its own, only a psionic link.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 7}} The suit can be sent out, whether by psionic or vocal command, to attach to a user aside from Tony, so as to either protect them or restrict their movement to only what Tony desires, but not capable of using the suit themselves due to his psionic connection.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 4}} The suit can {{Power|Telepathic Immunity|repel and stop telepathy}}.{{r|Avengers & X-Men: AXIS Vol 1 9}} This armor's {{Power|Repulsor Ray|repulstors}} are a white-blue in color, but when he is preparing to attack someone, they switch color to red for an air of menace. Due to his intrinsic connection to the armor biologically, his own eyes sometimes light up red or blue in addition to the lights on the armor itself.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 2}} These repulsors are so powerful that they can even bypass the ability of people such as [[Alexander Summers (Earth-616)|Havok]] to absorb energy.{{r|Avengers & X-Men: AXIS Vol 1 8}} There is an incorporated taser in the arms{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 2}} that can be used for sustained electrical impulses on command instead of short bursts.{{r|Avengers & X-Men: AXIS Vol 1 9}} The armor has the ability to fire threads of [[Repulsor]] energy to combat the magic spell to remove the moral inversion from AXIS.{{r|Avengers & X-Men: AXIS Vol 1 9}} The armor can also {{Power|Energy Absorption|absorb electromagnetic energy}} once it finds the correct frequency of said energy. However, though living beings of electromagnetic energy such as [[Monica Rambeau (Earth-616)|Spectrum]] can be absorbed, they can break free of the armor, causing the armor to temporarily dissolve in a select portion before reassembling.{{r|Captain America and the Mighty Avengers Vol 1 3}} The armor is also capable of withstanding the lightning called forth by [[Ororo Munroe (Earth-616)|Storm]] with minimal, if any damage.{{r|Avengers & X-Men: AXIS Vol 1 8}} The armor is capable of withstanding a beatdown from [[Cabal (Namor) (Earth-616)|The Cabal]], leaving the armor damaged but the user unharmed, and {{Power|Limited Shapeshifting|transforming}} into a form that looks similar to a mech suit that comes equipped with blasters as arms, arms that are potent enough to vaporize the upper half of [[Corvus Glaive (Earth-616)]].{{r|New Avengers Vol 3 26}} There is a thruster behind the elbows of the armor's arms, allowing for increased power when punching or otherwise striking someone, including allowing for needles to pass through tough skin.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 5}} [[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) from Superior Iron Man Vol 1 8 001.jpg|thumb|right|Hulk-like physique]] This armor's thrusters initially did not function when deprived of an oxygen-based environment, as they relied upon a combustion engine,{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 7}} but this was later rectified.{{r|Avengers Vol 5 44}} The armor can survive and maneuver with ease in the vacuum of space and operate comfortably close to the sun and withstand [[Sol's Hammer]] exploding around it.{{r|Avengers Vol 5 44}} This armor can be used to subjugate possessing entities, such as an eight-year-prior incarnation of Tony Stark who had possessed a version of the [[Iron Man Armor Model 2]].{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 7}} When the main faceplate is removed, a {{WP|Graphene}} layer replaces it, to allow for bulletproofing of the face while providing an unobstructed view of said area of the head.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 2}} The armor can also have more of its forming compound added to increase its size, granting the suit a Hulk-like physique.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 8}} This makes it strong enough to completely annihilate multiple older [[Iron Man Armor]] and defeat the [[Iron Man Armor Model 36|Model 36]] with complete ease.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 9}} The armor can release tendrils of its material to enter automated armors in order to determine the source of their core-artificial intelligence. The same tendrils can be spread out even further, making a punch capable of causing an armor to explode from the inside out from the internal force.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 9}} Unlike most symbiotes, Tony Stark has shielded this one against sonic attacks.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 9}} | AlternateVersions = ===Earth-61284=== [[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-61284) from Marvel Avengers Academy 010.png|thumb|right]] On [[Earth-61284]], the Iron Man Armor Model 5.1 was a collaboration between [[Anthony Stark (Earth-61284)|Iron Man]] and [[Janet Van Dyne (Earth-61284)|Wasp]]. When [[Van Dyne Design Studio|Van Dyne's Outfits]] opened, Wasp offered to create outfits for the other [[Avengers Academy (Earth-61284)|Avengers Academy]] students. While Wasp designed the exterior, Iron Man designed the operating systems. The armor functioned mostly the same as his main armor, but with the capacity to fire more missiles more quickly.{{r|Marvel Avengers Academy}} | Notes = * The Endo-Sym Armor is similar in concept to Hall Industries' [[Iron Rangers (Earth-616)|Iron Rangers]], who wore bio-mechanical armor made from cybernetically-enhanced samples of the [[Carnage (Symbiote) (Earth-616)|Carnage symbiote]].{{r|Carnage Vol 1 2}} | Trivia = | Links = }} [[Category:Unique Items]] [[Category:Symbiote-Derived Items]] [[Category:Artificial Symbiotes]] [[Category:Anthony Stark (Earth-51156)/Items]]

| History                 = {{Quote|Dang. Looks like this is gonna be a... harder '''nut''' to crack than I thought. What? I'm allowed. It makes sense with the suit.|[[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Iron Man]]|Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Beats Up the Marvel Universe! Vol 1 1}}

After his [[Iron Man Armor Model 51|conventional armor]] failed at stopping [[Doreen Green (Earth-616)|Squirrel Girl]]'s evil clone [[Allene Green (Earth-616)|Allene]], [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] hastily designed a new suit specifically to take down the newly-surfaced villain.

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) from Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Beats Up the Marvel Universe! Vol 1 1 001.jpg|thumb|left]]
Iron Man assembled a group of [[Avengers (Earth-616)|Avengers]] intended to meet up with the original Squirrel Girl, but they were tricked by Allene into meeting up with her instead, setting up a trap in the form of an electrified floor that knocked down all the heroes except Iron Man. Even though his suit could counter her abilities, Allene started attacking him with his teammates' arsenal. She eventually neutralized Iron Man by shooting him with [[Clinton Barton (Earth-616)|Hawkeye]]'s putty arrows, and then throwing his unconscious teammates on him, so they sticked to the armor. This prevented Tony from retaliating without risking his teammates' safety. Allene breached the suit's helmet and knocked out Tony with a punch. When Allene stole the Avengers' equipment to continue fighting the rest of the heroes and villains, she took the armor's right glove.

After putting together a contingent of the remaining superhumans to stop Allene, the original Squirrel Girl ended up being accidentally teleported to the [[Moon]] by Allene. [[Tippy-Toe (Earth-616)|Tippy-Toe]] stole both Allene's hand-held teleporter and the Iron Man armor gauntlet and flew to Allene's abandoned base in [[Brooklyn]], where [[Mjolnir]] laid untouched ever since [[Jane Foster (Earth-616)|Thor]]'s defeat. Using the teleporter, Tippy sent Mjolnir to the Moon in order to save Squirrel Girl.{{r|Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Beats Up the Marvel Universe! Vol 1 1}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) from Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Beats Up the Marvel Universe! Vol 1 1 003.jpg|thumb|250px|right]]
==Properties==
===Overview===
This suit was built with the exclusive purpose to precisely counter the abilities of [[Doreen Green (Earth-616)|Squirrel Girl]], or rather her evil clone [[Allene Green (Earth-616)|Allene]]. The armor's section modeled after a squirrel's head also functions as a backup [[Arc Reactor|R.T. node]]. [[Friday Stark (Earth-616)|Friday]] is present as the suit's on-board computer.{{r|Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Beats Up the Marvel Universe! Vol 1 1}}

===Offensive Powers===
[[Glossary:Repulsor|Repulsor]] weaponry comes equipped in the armor, including hand blasts powerful enough to tear down a wall and knock out the [[T'Challa (Earth-616)|Black Panther]].{{r|Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Beats Up the Marvel Universe! Vol 1 1}}

===Defensive Powers===
The armor's pilot can be insulated from electrical attacks, with emergency countermeasures being able to shunt the electricity into the R.T. node. The armor's hull is additionally extremely resistant, as it takes a person with superhuman strength to breach it.{{r|Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Beats Up the Marvel Universe! Vol 1 1}}

* The numerical designation provided in this article for this suit is tentative, based on the last officially numbered armor ([[Iron Man Armor Model 52|Model 52]]) and the chronological appearance of this suit.

| History                 = This [[Iron Man Armor]] was built by [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] in preparation for the final showdown against [[Carol Danvers (Earth-616)|Captain Marvel]] during the [[Civil War II|second superhuman civil war]]. After the [[Inhumans (Inhomo supremis)|Inhuman]] profiler [[Ulysses Cain (Earth-616)|Ulysses Cain]] foretold [[Steven Rogers (Earth-61311)|Captain America]]'s assassination at the hands of [[Miles Morales (Earth-1610)|Spider-Man]] on the steps of the [[Capitol Building]], the young hero travelled to [[Washington, D.C.]] to face his possible fate and ensure it didn't come true. As soon as Spider-Man's whereabouts made it to the news, Tony donned the suit of armor and rushed to [[Washington, D.C.]].{{r|Spider-Man Vol 2 9}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) from Spider-Man Vol 2 10 001.jpg|thumb|left|Iron Man attacking Captain Marvel]]
Iron Man jumped at [[Carol Danvers (Earth-616)|Captain Marvel]] when she approached Spider-Man in order to apprehend him, since she feared Ulysses' vision was going to come true. Iron Man and Captain Marvel engaged in a brutal fight.{{r|Civil War II Vol 1 7}} Carol eventually managed to turn the tide of the battle in her favor, as the systems of Tony's armor began to fail. Other heroes arrived to the scene in an attempt to stop the fight, but were too late to stop Danvers from dealing a decisive blow that obliterated the armor and knocked down Stark, causing him to slip into a coma.{{r|Civil War II Vol 1 8}}

==Properties==
===Overview===
This suit appears to work in a similar fashion to the [[Iron Man Armor Model 51|Model-Prime Armor]], meaning that its surface is composed of mostly exagonal scales that could rearrange themselves. The armor's systems included a HUD and [[Friday Stark (Earth-616)|Friday]] as the on-board computer. Scanners could be used to analyze vital signs.{{r|Civil War II Vol 1 8}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) vs. Carol Danvers (Earth-616) from Civil War II Vol 1 8 002.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The armor going up against Captain Marvel]]
===Offensive Powers===
The arsenal with which the suit was outfitted could be used to go toe-to-toe against [[Carol Danvers (Earth-616)|Captain Marvel]] for a limited period of time.{{r|Civil War II Vol 1 8}} It possessed [[Glossary:Repulsor|repulsor]] weaponry, including a unibeam and shoulder-mounted repulsor cannons,{{r|Civil War II Vol 1 7}} and a missile array capable of firing over twelve projectiles at once. The suit was strong enough to block Captain Marvel's blows and knock her back with a jet-assisted punch.{{r|Civil War II Vol 1 8}}

===Defensive Powers===
This armor was robust enough to withstand heavy blows from Captain Marvel before its systems failed. Its scaled surface grants the suit an unprecedented amount of additional durability, since portions of the casing blown off could realign themselves back into the armor.{{r|Civil War II Vol 1 8}}

==[[Multiverse|Alternate Realities]]==
===Captain Marvel Lost Civil War II ([[Earth-669]])===
[[File:Iron Man Armor Model 54 from Infinity Countdown Captain Marvel Vol 1 1 001.jpg|thumb|right]]
In this reality, the final battle of the civil war took a different turn when [[Carol Danvers (Earth-669)|Captain Marvel]] conceded that [[Anthony Stark (Earth-669)|Iron Man]] was right and that [[Miles Morales (Earth-669)|Spider-Man]] should be let go free, and attempted to fire an energy blast at the energy bubble surrounding Miles to break it open. Unfortunately, Iron Man misinterpreted Carol's actions as hostile, and used the Iron Man Armor's unibeam to fire a devastating energy blast that knocked her unconscious.{{r|Infinity Countdown: Captain Marvel Vol 1 1}}

| CurrentOwner            = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]]
| PreviousOwners          = 

| Notes                   = * The armor features a color scheme reminiscent of the [[War Machine Armor]]. Rhodey's death represented the boiling point of the conflict between Tony Stark and Carol Danver over [[Ulysses Cain (Earth-616)|Ulysses Cain]].
* The suit sports the same shape of unibeam as the [[Iron Man Armor Model 51|Model-Prime Armor]], and its helmet is extremely similar to the helmet design used by the [[Iron Man Armor (Earth-199999)|Iron Man Armor]] in the [[Earth-199999|Marvel Cinematic Universe]]. Its forehead includes a triangle in a similar manner to the [[Iron Man Armor Model 25]].
* The numerical designation provided in this article for this suit is tentative, based on the last officially numbered armor ([[Iron Man Armor Model 52|Model 52]]) and the chronological appearance of this suit.
| Trivia                  = * {{cl|Civil War II Vol 1}} writer [[Brian Michael Bendis]] has revealed he called this armor the "Marvel Buster" in his scripts, and that it is supposedly stronger than his [[Hulkbuster Armor]]. He additionally stated this suit has a power source unique to others. He also teased that the armor was going to resurface.{{cite|ref=true|url=http://brianmichaelbendis.tumblr.com/post/155184149377/was-iron-mans-buster-in-civil-war-ii-stronger|title=BENDIS!|work=Tumblr|first=Brian|last=Bendis|date=December 30, 2016|accessdate=February 27, 2018|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20250827230015/https://brianmichaelbendis.tumblr.com/post/155184149377/was-iron-mans-buster-in-civil-war-ii-stronger|archivedate=August 27, 2025}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) from Hunt for Wolverine Dead Ends Vol 1 1 001.jpg|thumb|left|Tony Stark riding the armor as a motorbike]]

This suit is most likely designed with the main purpose to operate as a regular motorbike as well. The armor additionally seems to possess many configurations, including a heavy weapons mode. When deployed into a suit, the armor appears to possess the standard abilities of a regular Iron Man Armor, including flight. Once deployed, all of the motorbike's components turn into the armor, with the exception of the wheels. {{Marvel Database: Item Template | Image = Iron Man Armor Model 58 from Tony Stark Iron Man Vol 1 18 008.jpg | Title = [[Iron Man Armor|Iron Man Armor Model 58]]
Nano Iron Man Armor | Name = | Aliases = * Nano Iron Man{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 1}} * Nano-Armor{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 1}} | Model = 1 | Version = 1 | Reality = Earth-616 | LeadDesigner = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] | AdditionalDesigners = [[Stark Unlimited (Earth-616)|Stark Unlimited]] | PlaceOfCreation = [[Stark Unlimited HQ]], [[New York City]], [[New York (State)|New York]] | PlaceOfDestruction = | Origin = | Type = Iron Man Armor | Dimensions = | Weight = | Creators = Dan Slott; Valerio Schiti | First = Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 1 | History = The Nano Iron Man Armor was developed by [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] after founding [[Stark Unlimited (Earth-616)|Stark Unlimited]]. When the [[Basil Sandhurst (Earth-616)|Controller]] used a [[Slave Discs|Control Disk]] to send [[Fin Fang Foom (Earth-616)|Fin Fang Foom]] to attack [[Manhattan]], Iron Man initially confronted him using the giant-sized [[Iron Man Armor Model 57|Fin Fang Foombuster]]. When the suit failed, he created an opening in the creature's hide and fired a pod carrying a swarm of Nano Iron Man Armor in order to deploy them into his bloodstream so he could investigate his uncharacteristic behavior. [[File:Iron Man Armor Model 58 from Tony Stark Iron Man Vol 1 1 004.jpg|thumb|left]] Tony initially only remotelly-piloted a single nanobot, since he hadn't figure out a way to make them properly work in tandem. With [[Andrew Bhang (Earth-616)|Andy Bhang]]'s help, Stark solved the issue and managed to have the entire swarm follow his lead in order to fight off Foom's antibodies and reach his brain stem. After stumbling upon the Control Disk, Tony used the lead nanobot to destroy it.{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 1}} After Tony became molecularly bonded to his [[Iron Man Armor Model 65|Ultronbuster Armor]] in an accident while fighting [[Ultron (Earth-616)|Ultron Pym]],{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 16}} he piloted one of the Nano Armor into his own body as part of the preparations for a separation process designed by Stark Unlimited expert [[Doctor Shapiro (Earth-616)|Dr. Shapiro]], which required him to tag with ionic energy all the mechanical parts to the phased out of his body.{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 18}} ==Properties== ===Overview=== The Nano Iron Man Armor is microbot piloted remotely by its user. It is capable of firing both repulsor blasts and channeled repulsors. Through a lead nanobot which provides the rest a beat to syncopate to, a thousand of these micro-suits work in tandem. The suit is also equipped with speaker systems.{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 1}} In order to help prepare [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony]]'s body for a separation procedure when he became molecularly fused to his [[Iron Man Armor Model 65|armor]], the Nano Armor was modified to be able to permeate ionic energy.{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 18}} | CurrentOwner = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] | PreviousOwners = | Notes = * The numerical designation provided in this article for this suit is tentative, based on the last officially numbered armor ([[Iron Man Armor Model 52|Model 52]]) and the chronological appearance of this suit. | Trivia = | Links = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Iron_Man_Armor_Model_058|noerror}} [[Category:Nanobots]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Marvel Database:Item Template | Image = Iron Man Armor Model 6 from All-New Iron Manual Vol 1 1 002.jpg | Name = Iron Man Armor Model 6 | Title = [[Stealth Armor]] | Aliases = * Iron Man Armor Model 7{{r|Iron Manual Vol 1 1}} * Iron Man Armor Mark VI{{r|House of X Vol 1 1}} | Model = 6 | Version = 2 | Reality = Earth-616 | LeadDesigner = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] | AdditionalDesigners = | PlaceOfCreation = | PlaceOfDestruction = | Origin = | Type = Iron Man Armor | Dimensions = | Weight = | Creators = David Michelinie; Bob Layton; John Romita Jr. | First = Iron Man Vol 1 152 | History = Designed after Tony was detected approaching a Roxxon space station using the [[Iron Man Armor Model 5|Space Armor]], the Stealth Armor was created to focus on stealth over offensive weaponry. It was used by Stark to infiltrate the [[Der Hand von Himmel|Heaven's Hand]] fortress in the area formerly known as East Germany.{{r|Iron Man Vol 1 152}} The Stealth Armor was later used by Stark to infiltrate Soviet airspace during the first Armor Wars. By this point, Tony had managed to upgrade the suit to give it limited weapons capability where the original was basically defenseless.{{r|Iron Man Vol 1 229}} When [[Anthony Stark (Earth-96020)|Teen Tony]] and [[James Rhodes (Earth-616)|War Machine]] battled [[Stockpile (Earth-616)|Stockpile]], their employer [[Morgan Stark (Earth-616)|Morgan Stark]] attempted to remotely control a number of older armors, including a stealth model.{{r|Iron Man Vol 1 330|331}} ==Capabilities== The Stealth Armor maximizes concealment over everything else. As a result, it is more fragile and cannot fit into a briefcase. Radar-absorbing coating, electronic countermeasure (ECM) jamming, and a wave-modifying plasma layer held by a force field distort incoming radar and sonar signals. Emissions from the jets are washed by supercooled air as the boots themselves have liquid oxygen rings. If discovered, it could launch chaff. Subterranean equipment was added for reaching underground areas. The sensory systems were upgraded for stealth missions, including an "auto-camera" with microfilm and a sonic scan probe. The original model had no weapons systems. A later version had limited weaponry: repulsors have enough charge for three shots. Its unibeam is usable but similarly low-powered.{{cl|Iron Man Annual Vol 1 13}}, [[Iron Manual Vol 1 1|Iron Manual]] The later upgrades included the ability for the armor to change color for stealth purposes, although this camouflage ability was limited to working only in environments that were of one color, such as snow. A booster pack conserves energy and increases the armor's long range capability. [[File:A + X Vol 1 7 Many Armors of Iron Man Variant Textless.jpg|thumb|left]] ==Alternate Reality Versions==
Image Description Issue
[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-91119) from Marvel Super Hero Squad Online 003.png|150px]] This special sneaky armor may let Iron Man scout behind enemy lines without being seen, but it still packs quite a punch! ''[[Marvel Super Hero Squad Online]]''
[[File:Marvel Duel Card 0099.png|150px]] In [[Earth-60713]], the Iron Man Armor Model 6 resembled the [[Iron Man Armor Model 43]]. The only visual difference was the biceps were black rather than silver. ''[[Marvel Duel]]''
| CurrentOwner = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] | PreviousOwners = | Notes = * This armor, the [[Iron Man Armor Model 7|Silver Centurion Armor]] and the [[Iron Man Armor Model 8|Hydro Armor]] were originally identified in 1993's {{cl|Iron Manual Vol 1 1}} as Models 7, 8 and 6, respectively. However, these designations did not correspond with the chronological order in which these suits debuted ({{cl|Iron Man Vol 1 152}}, {{cl|Iron Man Vol 1 200|#200}} and {{cl|Iron Man Vol 1 218|#218}}). In 2018, the [[:Category:Many Armors of Iron Man Variants|"Many Armors of Iron Man"]] variant cover series for {{cl|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 1}}, their numbers are shuffled around to match the sequence in which they first appeared. * The Stealth Armor is actually black, appearing as blue only because of the printing limitations of the era, in which blue had to be used as a fill-in for black surfaces and objects.{{cite web|url=http://brevoortformspring.tumblr.com/post/47779009836/the-stealth-suit-is-blue-tom-no-wonder-your-books|title=New Brevoort Formspring — The Stealth suit is blue Tom. No wonder...|work=Tumblr|first=Tom|last=Brevoort|date=12 April 2013|accessdate=17 January 2020}} A caption in the cover to the suit's first appearance, {{cl|Iron Man Vol 1 152}}, calls Iron Man the "now-ebon Avenger," and in {{cl|Iron Man Vol 1 244}}, the [[Norbert Ebersol (Earth-616)|Fixer]] specifically denotes that Iron Man is wearing a black armor. * The Stealth Suit was based on the {{WP|Northrop Grumman B-2 Spirit}}. | Trivia = * This suit is one of Iron Man's armors whose schematics are being contested by [[Damage Control (Earth-616)|Damage Control]] after Tony Stark fell into a coma since the company also operates as an archival unit for metahuman technology that belongs to missing, incapacitated or deceased individuals. While Stark commonly evaded this predicament by leaving control of his intellectual property to [[Reed Richards (Earth-616)|Reed Richards]], Reed had gone missing for a prolonged period of time when Stark became incapacitated.{{r|House of X Vol 1 1}} | Links = }} [[Category:Unique Items]]

This armor was one of the many designed by [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] after founding [[Stark Unlimited (Earth-616)|Stark Unlimited]]. He used it in its {{WP|Vespa}} mode to explore [[Manhattan]] on a date with [[Janet Van Dyne (Earth-616)|Janet Van Dyne]]. When the date was interrupted by an alert from [[Bethany Cabe (Earth-616)|Bethany Cabe]] because the [[Stark Unlimited HQ]] was under attack from robots sent by [[Baintronics Incorporated (Earth-616)|Baintronics]], Tony hopped back into the Vespa and activated its armor configuration. Together with Wasp, Iron Man helped stop Baintronics' robots.{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 4}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) and Janet Van Dyne (Earth-616) from Tony Stark Iron Man Vol 1 4 001.jpg|thumb|left|The armor as a Vespa]]
==Properties==
===Overview===
This armor's main feature is the ability to switch between a transportation mode and an [[Iron Man Armor]] mode. In its transportation mode, the suit resembles a red and gold {{WP|Vespa}}. In a matter of seconds, the Vespa can transform and encase its user in a fully-functional Iron Man suit. The Vespa's front bumper and rear end become the armor's left and right shoulderguard, respectively. The front protection comprises the armor's chest plate. The wheels are retracted to the back of the armor, and the handlebars to the shoulders. The protective helmet used in conjunction with the Vespa also transforms into part of the armor, unfolding into a fully-encasing helmet.

When deployed, the suit appears to possess the standard abilities of a regular Iron Man Armor, including flight and repulsor blasts. At least one of the handlebars can be unsheathed to reveal an energy sword.{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 2}}

pages.wikitext:
{{Marvel Database: Item Template | Image = Iron Man Armor Model 63 from Tony Stark Iron Man Vol 1 10 001.jpg | Title = [[Iron Man Armor|Iron Man Armor Model 63]]
Godbuster Armor | Name = | Aliases = Godkiller Armor{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 11}} | Model = 1 | Version = 1 | Reality = Earth-616 | LeadDesigner = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] | AdditionalDesigners = | PlaceOfCreation = Baintronics Manufacturing and Fulfillment Center, [[Cranbury|Cranbury Township]], [[New Jersey (State)|New Jersey]] | PlaceOfDestruction = Baintronics Manufacturing and Fulfillment Center, [[Cranbury|Cranbury Township]], [[New Jersey (State)|New Jersey]] | Origin = | Type = Iron Man Armor | Dimensions = | Weight = | Creators = Dan Slott; Jim Zub; Alexander Lozano | First = Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 10 | Destruction = Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 11 | History = {{Quote|It's [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony]]'s '''masterpiece.''' He built the '''ultimate weapon.'''|[[Arno Stark (Earth-616)|Arno Stark]]|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 11}} The Godbuster Armor originated within the [[Project eScape|eScape]], a virtual reality developed by [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]]. When Tony was abducted by the eScape's rogue operating system [[Mistress (Earth-616)|Motherboard]], he eventually broke free from her influence and rebelled against her. The eScape allowed Tony's mind to become unfettered from the restrains of the human brain, and the full power of his imagination unleashed conceived the Godbuster Armor, a powerful suit which allowed him to destroy Motherboard.{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 10}} Concurrently with the tribulations caused by Motherboard, the [[Basil Sandhurst (Earth-616)|Controller]] was leeching energy off the eScape users, gaining enormous power and becoming near-unstoppable. After coming back from the eScape, Tony hijacked the bleeding edge 3D printers in possession of [[Baintronics Incorporated (Earth-616)|Baintronics]] to construct the Godbuster Armor in real life, with the limitations of his human body already causing the intricacies of the design to fade from his memory. Once finished, Iron Man used the Godbuster Armor to effortlessly stop the villain and knock him out. Afterwards, Tony piloted the suit back into the Baintronics factory and had it self-destruct, taking the resources used to build it with it, since he determined the armor was too powerful to remain in the real world. At the request of Tony's adoptive brother and Baintronics' co-leader [[Arno Stark (Earth-616)|Arno]], the company's technicians managed to recover fragments of data on the Godbuster Armor from the destroyed facility.{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 11}} After Arno deposed Tony from [[Stark Unlimited (Earth-616)|Stark Unlimited]] and merged it with Baintronics, he poured the resources of both companies into trying to recreate the Godbuster Armor, with the resulting suit become Arno's [[Iron Man Armor Model 67|own Iron Man Armor]].{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 19}} ==Properties== ===Overview=== Little is known of the Godbuster Armor's full capabilities. [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]]'s brother [[Arno Stark (Earth-616)|Arno Stark]] deemed it as Tony's masterpiece and described the armor as the "ultimate weapon." When [[Riri Williams (Earth-616)|Ironheart]] scanned Iron Man, his power readings were off the scale, and the armor radiated much more power than anything she had ever seen. Aside from that, the armor gave Iron Man enhanced strength, and allowed him to fly and release powerful repulsor barrages capable of knocking down gigantic foes.{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 11}} With one blast, the Godbuster Armor wiped out an entire digital universe and [[Mistress (Earth-616)|Motherboard]] which promptly shut down the [[Project eScape|eScape]].{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 10}} The Godbuster Armor was able to knock out a giant [[Basil Sandhurst (Earth-616)|Controller]] that had absorbed the cerebral energy in the hundreds of thousands of users in the [[Project eScape|eScape]] for a while.{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 9}}{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 11}} | CurrentOwner = | PreviousOwners = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] | Notes = * The numerical designation provided in this article for this suit is tentative, based on the last officially numbered armor ([[Iron Man Armor Model 52|Model 52]]) and the chronological appearance of this suit. * This armor's design is partially inspired by the [[Iron Man 2020 Armor]] of [[Earth-8410]]. * This suit has alternated between the nicknames Godbuster Armor and Godkiller Armor. It was originally presented in {{cl|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 10}} as the Godbuster Armor, and it was referred to as such in issue {{cl|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 19}}. It was called the Godkiller Armor in issue {{cl|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 11}} and in {{cl|Iron Man 2020 Vol 2 3}}. * Despite being referred to as the Godkiller Armor, this suit has no relation to the original [[Godkiller Armor]], a gigantic suit built by the [[Aspirants]]. | Trivia = | Links = }} [[Category:Destroyed Items]]

Tony was wearing it when [[Sinclair Abbott (Earth-616)|Spymaster]] infiltrated the [[Stark Unlimited HQ]] and stole a hard drive containing a back-up of Stark's memories. He used the armor to defeat the villain along with [[Carol Danvers (Earth-616)|Captain Marvel]].{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 14}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) from Tony Stark Iron Man Vol 1 14 008.jpg|thumb|left]]
Tony continued using this armor, and for a brief time employed his duplicate A.I., dubbed [[Anthony Stark (Third A.I.) (Earth-616)|Li'l Tony]], to run its systems. After fighting a hybrid of [[Simon Williams (Earth-616)|Wonder Man]] and [[Vision (Earth-616)|Vision]], during which Li'l Tony was killed,{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 15}} and becoming aware of a ploy by [[Ultron (Earth-616)|Ultron Pym]], Tony switched this armor in favor of a specialty suit, the [[Iron Man Armor Model 65|Ultronbuster Armor]].{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 16}} Stark didn't return to the Model 64 following his confrontation against Ultron since he lacked an A.I. to run its systems,{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 18}} and later because he renounced his identity as Tony Stark, and opted to use a new version of his [[Iron Man Armor Model 1|Model 1 Armor]] under his new name of Mark One.{{r|Iron Man 2020 Vol 2 1}}
| Properties              = 
===Overview===
This suit appears to possess the standard abilities of a regular Iron Man Armor, including flight, enhanced strength, increased durability, repulsor blasts and unibeam. The suit can additionally deploy repulsor rays from its shoulders, generate energy shields,{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 14}} and set off an EMP. While the EMP also causes the suit to shut down, countermeasures enable its reboot. For a brief time, the armor's systems were operated by [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]]'s A.I. duplicate, dubbed [[Anthony Stark (Third A.I.) (Earth-616)|Li'l Tony]].{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 15}} The armor can withstand blows from previous iterations of armor and emit a widespread ray of light from its chest piece.{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 14}} The armor was durable enough to withstand blows from an android that was a combination of [[Simon Williams (Earth-616)|Wonder Man]] and [[Vision (Earth-616)|Vision]].{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 15}}

{{Marvel Database: Item Template | Image = Iron Man Armor Model 65.jpg | Title = [[Iron Man Armor|Iron Man Armor Model 65]]
Ultronbuster Armor | Name = | Aliases = Ultronbuster{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 16}} | Model = 1 | Version = 1 | Reality = Earth-616 | LeadDesigner = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] | AdditionalDesigners = [[Stark Unlimited (Earth-616)|Stark Unlimited]] | PlaceOfCreation = [[Stark Unlimited HQ]], [[New York City]], [[New York (State)|New York]] | PlaceOfDestruction = | Origin = | Type = Iron Man Armor | Dimensions = | Weight = | Creators = Dan Slott; Jim Zub; Valerio Schiti | First = Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 16 | History = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] had been tinkering away on an Ultronbuster Armor before the situation to use it presented itself. It occurred when the villain, in his [[Ultron (Earth-616)|Ultron Pym]] form, kidnapped Stark's girlfriend, the [[Janet Van Dyne (Earth-616)|Wasp]]. Having deduced that Ultron was behind the kidnapping, Tony suited up in the Ultronbuster before going on the search of [[Jocasta Pym (Earth-616)|Jocasta]], whom Stark believed was in danger but had already been captured as well. Iron Man and his allies eventually located Ultron Pym's lair at the abeyant [[Avengers Mansion]] and managed to free both captives from a device intended to fuse them molecularly. However, Stark was caught by the blast of the machine right after rescuing the Wasp, causing Tony's human body to become mangled and fused to the Ultronbuster.{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 16}} [[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) from Tony Stark Iron Man Vol 1 16 014.jpg|thumb|left|Tony becoming fused to the armor]] Iron Man managed to keep fighting despite the fusion, constantly reprogramming the armor on the fly to work with his internal organs and postpone fatal injuries. Once Tony's team at [[Stark Unlimited (Earth-616)|Stark Unlimited]] discovered a way to undo Ultron's process, Jocasta helped Iron Man retreat.{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 17}} Using the remotely-controlled [[Iron Man Armor Model 58|Nano Iron Man Armor]] on his own body, Tony ionically tagged all mechanical parts to be expelled from his body. Despite completing only ninety-seven percent of the preparations, Tony decided to star the separation process due to the threat posed by a miniature Ultron drone who had infilitrated Tony's systems. The split was successful, and the pieces of the armor were phased out of Tony's body, returning it to normal.{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 18}} ==Properties== ===Overview=== This suit appears to possess the standard abilities of a regular Iron Man Armor, including flight, enhanced strength, increased durability that allowed the armor to tank blows from [[Ultron (Earth-616)|Ultron Pym]]{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 17}}, repulsor blasts and unibeam. The suit can additionally generate energy shields, and its chestplate conceals a missile pod.{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 16}} | CurrentOwner = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] | PreviousOwners = | Notes = * The numerical designation provided in this article for this suit is tentative, based on the last officially numbered armor ([[Iron Man Armor Model 52|Model 52]]) and the chronological appearance of this suit. | Trivia = | Links = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Iron_Man_Armor_Model_065|noerror}}

This "Ice Age Man" armor was powered by [[Vibranium]] batteries and used circuitry salvaged from the ruined [[Iron Man Armor Model 29|Extremis Armor]]. This armor was used in battle against [[Mephisto (Earth-616)|Mephisto]], but it began to break apart by a combination of the demon's attacks and the high battery usage causing it to melt. Stark concentrated all of the armor's power in a [[Glossary:Repulsor|repulsor]] blast directed towards the [[Time Stone]] in Mephisto's possession. The attack caused the suit to shatter, but Tony was returned to his time afterward.{{r|Avengers Vol 8 31}} ==Properties== ===Overview=== As an incredibly low-tech armor, the Ice Armor seemed only have very basic offensive capabilities, {{Power|Ice Generation|firing icicles}} from a wrist cannon. It was capable of a [[Glossary:repulsor|repulsor]] blast, but the more [[Vibranium]] power used by the armor, the more it melted. In regards to defensive capabilities, the armor did allow Tony to survive going toe-to-toe with [[Mephisto (Earth-616)|Mephisto]], though the armor was damaged by the demon's blows.{{r|Avengers Vol 8 31}} | CurrentOwner = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] | PreviousOwners = | Notes = * The numerical designation provided in this article for this suit is tentative, based on the last officially numbered armor ([[Iron Man Armor Model 52|Model 52]]) and the chronological appearance of this suit. | Trivia = | Links = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Iron_Man_Armor_Model_066|noerror}}

pages.wikitext:
{{Marvel Database: Item Template | Image = Iron Man Armor Model 68 from Iron Man 2020 Vol 2 5 001.jpg | Title = [[Iron Man Armor|Iron Man Armor Model 68]]
Virtual Armor | Name = | Aliases = * Virtual Armor{{r|Iron Man 2020 Vol 2 5}} * Hologram Armor{{r|Iron Man 2020 Vol 2 6}} | Model = 1 | Version = 1 | Reality = Earth-616 | LeadDesigner = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] | AdditionalDesigners = [[Friday Stark (Earth-616)|Friday]] | PlaceOfCreation = [[Thirteenth Floor]] | PlaceOfDestruction = | Origin = | Type = Iron Man Armor | Dimensions = | Weight = | Creators = Dan Slott; Christos N. Gage; Pete Woods | First = Iron Man 2020 Vol 2 5 | Quotation = C'mon, [[Arno Stark (Earth-616)|Arno]]. Still making armor out of metal? How very '''2020'''. I'm a futurist. My new suit's made of an '''entire world'''-- the [[Project eScape|eScape]]. Solid hologram. Virtual Armor. '''Its''' only limit: '''my imagination'''. | Speaker = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Iron Man]] | QuoteSource = Iron Man 2020 Vol 2 5 | History = After finally realizing that he was the real [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] and not a duplicate of himself as he had come to firmly believe,{{r|Iron Man 2020 Vol 2 4}} Tony began work on the Model 68 armor using the virtual resources of the [[Thirteenth Floor]], where his consciousness was residing after being plucked out of his body by [[Friday Stark (Earth-616)|Friday]] to save his life. The end result was the Virtual Armor, made entirely out of solid holograms, which Tony praised as his greatest armor of all time. [[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) and Arno Stark (Earth-616) from Iron Man 2020 Vol 2 6 001.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tony trapping Arno in the Virtual Armor]] Once Tony's allies had restored his physical body, Tony used the Virtual Armor to transport his consciousness out of the Thirteenth Floor and into his body. Tony and his allies then followed [[Arno Stark (Earth-616)|Arno Stark]] to the [[Stark Space Station]] to stop him from activating a mind-controlling device to enslave all of humanity to fight the [[Extinction Entity (Earth-616)|Extinction Entity]]. After overpowering Arno in battle,{{r|Iron Man 2020 Vol 2 5}} and realizing that he wouldn't be able to convince him the Extinction Entity was a delusion in his head caused by his relapsing illness, Tony encased Arno in the Virtual Armor, forming a sphere around him to act as a life support system while also submerging him in a virtual dream in which the Extinction Entity was real and he got to defeat it.{{r|Iron Man 2020 Vol 2 6}} ==Properties== ===Overview=== Unlike other Iron Man Armor, the Model 68 armor isn't made of matter like metal. Instead, it is made of solid holograms derived from the [[Project eScape|eScape]]. This allows Tony to create any weapon he can think of, including repulsor beams and unibeams. The armor also augments Tony's strength to the point where he could easily rip apart the [[Iron Man Armor Model 67|armor]] of his brother [[Arno Stark (Earth-616)|Arno]]. Defensively, the armor can protect against standard weapons like missiles and unconventional ones like repulsor beams. Tony is aided in running the armor by the A.I. [[Friday Stark (Earth-616)|Friday]]. [[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) from Iron Man 2020 Vol 2 6 001.jpg|thumb|right|The suit appearing partially visible]] The armor's default mode makes it invisible and segments of the suit only become perceptible depending on the situation. For example, portions of the suit flashed when blocking [[Arno Stark (Earth-616)|Arno Stark]]'s attacks, the suit's arm appeared visible when Tony punched Arno, and the suit's leg could be seen when Tony was using the armor's jet boots to fly.{{r|Iron Man 2020 Vol 2 5}} In a simulated sequence within the eScape, Tony made the entirety of the armor visible and opaque when fighting the [[Extinction Entity (Earth-20106)|Extinction Entity]], and the suit also protected him from the vacuum of space.{{r|Iron Man 2020 Vol 2 6}} | CurrentOwner = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] | PreviousOwners = | Notes = * The numerical designation provided in this article for this suit is tentative, based on the last officially numbered armor ([[Iron Man Armor Model 52|Model 52]]) and the chronological appearance of this suit. | Trivia = | Links = }} [[Category:Holograms]] {{DEFAULTSORT:Iron_Man_Armor_Model_068|noerror}}

pages.wikitext:
{{Marvel Database:Item Template | Image = Iron Man Armor Model 7 from All-New Iron Manual Vol 1 1 001.jpg | Name = Iron Man Armor Model 7 | Title = [[Silver Centurion|Silver Centurion Armor]] | Aliases = * Iron Man Armor Model 7{{r|Iron Manual Vol 1 1}} * Silver Centurion Armor * Red and Silver Armor * Chameleon Armor * Iron Man Armor Mark VII{{r|House of X Vol 1 1}} | Model = 7 | Version = 1 | Reality = Earth-616 | LeadDesigner = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] | AdditionalDesigners = | PlaceOfCreation = | PlaceOfDestruction = | Origin = This armor was built by Tony Stark as the next generation of Iron Man technology. | Type = Iron Man Armor | Dimensions = | Weight = | Creators = Dennis O'Neil; Mark Bright; Bob Layton | First = Iron Man Vol 1 200 | Destruction = | History = While he intended the armor to be used by [[James Rhodes (Earth-616)|James Rhodes]], Stark ended up donning it himself to gain revenge against [[Obadiah Stane (Earth-616)|Obadiah Stane]]. The armor prevailed against the [[Iron Monger Armor|Iron Monger's armor]] and Stark kept the design for many months. It was used extensively against other armor users during the first [[Armor Wars I|Armor Wars]] until being destroyed with one of [[Firepower]]'s powerful heat-seeking missiles. Stark used this opportunity to fake the death of the Iron Man who had apparently gone renegade and attacked the other armor wearers by sending it out on remote with various blood packs inside it, allowing him to claim that a new Iron Man wore the suit later. [[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-616) from Iron Man Vol 1 200 001.jpg|thumb|left|125px]] A replica of the armor was later used by [[Michael O'Brien (Earth-616)|Mike O'Brien]] to face [[Ultimo (Earth-616)|Ultimo]].{{r|Iron Man Vol 1 300}} Tony used another version of this armor when he was facing the [[Mandarin (Earth-616)|Mandarin]]'s attempt to unleash Extremis on a large scale, as his [[Extremis (Virus)|Extremis]] abilities- and thus his access to his more modern suits- had been shut down for a week out of concerns for his mental health.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 1 28}} When [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] undertook Stark Resilient, he dismantled and melted one version of this armor. After Tony underwent a moral inversion, [[Virginia Potts (Earth-616)|Pepper]] activated an [[Anthony Stark (First A.I.) (Earth-616)|artificial back-up]] Tony had made of his mind in the event of him ever being compromised in this kind of manner. Although the armor that the suit was using initially was destroyed, the A.I. then transferred itself into a model of this armor.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 8}} ==Capabilities== Flight was improved with new turbines for the {{Power|Self-Propelled Flight|boot jets}}. A separate booster pack could also be used. Individual armor parts stored a small emergency charge. {{Power|Concussive Blasts|Repulsors}} and the uni-beam were enhanced. Pulse bolts gained energy as they traveled up to a certain point. Other weapons included a {{Power|Heat Generation|heat lance}}, {{Power|Energy Projection|cutting lasers}}, an {{Power|Electricity Generation|electric shock}}, variator rays, a tractor beam, and a net.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 5 6}} A disruptor field was used against electrical systems. The sonic distorter could also be to disrupt opponents. Freon streams handled fire. A 'six-second' {{Power|Force Field|force-field}} greatly enhanced protection for a short time, but consumed considerable power. Refractory coating blunted lasers and other energy attacks. An absorption grid could be used to absorb energy from various sources. Life support equipment was considerably enhanced: recycled air, water and nutrients could last an indefinite amount of time. The "chameleon effect" generated a hologram to make the armor blend in with its surroundings. Due to harmful interference with his nervous system, Stark limited its use. Electromagnetic sensors could determine layouts of structures and identify stolen Stark technology. Negator packs neutralized and destroyed stolen Stark technology. The armor could withstand a bomb made from a higher yield of the [[Simon Williams (Earth-616)|Wonder Man's]] energy at point-blank range.{{r|West Coast Avengers Vol 4 9}} '''{{Power|Telepathic Immunity}}:''' Stark installed a [[Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division (Earth-616)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]] anti-telepathy device reverse-engineered from [[Magneto's Helmet]].{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 5 6}} '''Magnetic Immunity:''' The armor has a force-field capable of resisting [[Monica Rambeau (Earth-616)|Captain Marvel]]'s magnetism.{{r|West Coast Avengers Annual Vol 1 2}} ==Alternate Reality Versions==
